g.text: This buffer does not operate when VCCA > VCCB. VCC must be greater than 3.3V.
Opened up heatsink area on bottom of PCB
Open JP1 if powering from a source that you do not want feeding back to USB
Caution: Module gets hot when reading at full power
Added thermals to user solderable GND connections
SJ1 and SJ2 select between PCB antenna and the u.FL connector.
Note: This device operates in the 860MHz and 920MHz bands. Other devices operating near these bands will be affected and affect the performance of the reader.
Finalized trace antenna design and matching network
Decreased size of RF pad to avoid GND pad on module
Internal DC-DC will use the following: 900mA @ 5V 1100mA @ 3.7V
These 3 GPIO-LV pins are 3.3V tolerant. Do not expose them to 5V.
See 'Antenna Considerations' of Design Guide when using an external antenna.
